campaign.title: Rename CASE001_CLAMP preserving semantic identity and call bindings.

initial.code:
FUNCTION CASE001_CLAMP(X)
  CASE001_CLAMP = X
  IF (X < -11) THEN
    CASE001_CLAMP = -11
  END IF
  IF (X > 18) THEN
    CASE001_CLAMP = 18
  END IF
  CASE001_CLAMP = CASE001_CLAMP
END FUNCTION
FUNCTION CASE_001_ACCEPTED(X)
  CASE_001_ACCEPTED = 0
  IF (CASE001_CLAMP(X) >= 9) THEN
    CASE_001_ACCEPTED = 1
  END IF
  CASE_001_ACCEPTED = CASE_001_ACCEPTED
END FUNCTION
